Pains.title: What's quietly costing you <hl>customers</hl>
Pains.subtitle: It's not your team's fault. They're doing by hand what a well-built system does faster, without forgetting and without getting tired.

items.title: Calls that go to voicemail
items.text: You're on a job or with a client. The caller doesn't leave a message: they just call the next business on Google.

items.title: Messages left unanswered
items.text: A prospect writes in the evening or on the weekend. By morning, they've booked with whoever replied first.

items.title: Invoices nobody chases
items.text: Chasing payments is awkward, so it gets pushed back. Meanwhile, your cash sits with your customers.

items.title: Missed appointments
items.text: Without a reminder, some customers simply forget. The slot is lost and nobody fills it.

items.title: The same questions, a hundred times a week
items.text: Prices, opening hours, availability… Your team answers on repeat instead of handling real work.

items.title: Data typed in by hand
items.text: The same information entered in the spreadsheet, the CRM and the accounting tool. Mistakes are inevitable.

Pains.closing: The good news: all of this can be automated, with the tools you already use.

Faq.title: Questions we get before we start

items.q: Do I need any technical knowledge?
items.a: None. You tell us how you work; we handle everything technical and hand over a system that just runs, with simple documentation.

items.q: What if the AI gets it wrong or makes something up?
items.a: The assistant only answers from the information you give us: prices, hours, terms. If it doesn't know, it says so and passes the conversation to your team. You approve the tone and answers before anything goes live.

It depends on scope, which is why we quote after the free audit. Typically: a one-time setup, then a small monthly fee for hosting and maintenance. Most automations pay for themselves within a few weeks.
A simple automation ships in a few days, a larger system in a few weeks. The timeline is in your quote, and we deliver in stages so you see results early.

items.q: Will it work with the tools I already use?
items.a: Almost always. We connect what you already use: your phone line and text messages, WhatsApp, email, spreadsheets, CRM, calendar, online store, accounting software. You don't have to change anything.
Yes. We can host everything on your own servers or a private instance, credentials are stored securely, and every access is limited to the strict minimum.
Every system has automatic retries, fallbacks and alerts, so we're notified before you are. Maintenance is included in the monthly plan.

About.title: You talk <hl>directly</hl> to the people building your system
About.p1: Ottomate was founded by Damarus Ngankou, a software engineer specialized in AI and automation. Since 2024 he has been building production automations for digital agencies and neighborhood businesses alike.
About.p2: Our rule is simple: a system is only worth something if it runs without you. Every automation is tested on your real cases, monitored around the clock and clearly documented, so you always know what's going on.
About.p3: We work remotely with businesses around the world, in English and French. There's no salesperson between us: the person listening to you on the audit call is the one who builds.
